Maya (product): Heads up — we need to lock agenda owners for next week's cross-functional sync (roadmap + RFC reviews). Can we pick two owners and a triage lead? Prefer Wed 9:00am PT or Thu 4:00pm PT. @Ethan @Sam @Priya
Ethan (eng): I can own the RFC section. Wed 9am PT works for Eng. Suggest agenda: 1) quick metrics (5m) 2) RFC reviews (20m) 3) roadmap tradeoffs (25m) 4) action log + owners (5m).
Sam (eng-mgr): I can take triage lead and pull the open PR/blocker list. Prefer a 50-min slot so we don't rush.
Priya (design): Thu 4pm PT is easier for design folks. If Wed is chosen, can we record and allow async comments? I'll volunteer to collate design feedback.
Ben (product-ops): Calendar poll up: https://cal.poll/abc — please vote by EOD tomorrow. Also proposed agenda template I just added to the doc:
```
Agenda
- 5m Quick wins + metrics
- 20m RFC deep-dive (owner)
- 20m Roadmap tradeoffs (owner)
- 5m AOB + action owners
```
calendar-bot: Poll created by Ben: https://cal.poll/abc (expires in 48h).
Juno (sre): Please add a short "incident/readiness" check under AOB — last rollout missed that note and it bit us.
Ethan (eng): If Wed wins: Sam = triage, Ethan = RFCs, Maya = roadmap. Maya, can you confirm roadmap ownership?
Maya (product): Confirmed — I'll own the roadmap tradeoffs section and pin the decision-log in the invite. Link: https://redwood.docs/decision-log
Sam (eng-mgr): Will add the PR list + blockers to this thread before EOD.
Priya (design): I'll drop design links and mocks into the doc and tag which items need deterministic feedback.
Maya (product): Thanks all — plan: vote on poll, owners noted, I'll send the calendar invite once poll closes. :thumbsup:
Ethan (eng): +1
Sam (eng-mgr): +1
Ben (product-ops): Reminder: please set your Slack status if you can't attend so we can route questions async.
calendar-bot: Poll results summary will be posted here after expiry.
